I bought these for holiday photos and events. I am an absolute disaster with normal glue on lashes. I'm also weird about things near my eyes and these don't bother me. I can see them, but it's fine. It took me a couple tries but after about 10 minutes, I got it. I just practiced for a little bit and voilà. My only complaint is the little red dots for the top. I'm going to try to cover them at some point.
I was very disappointed with these lashes. It had described them as natural looking but they were not natural on my eyes - they were very thick/fake and I just could not get them to sit right.

Bought these for my wife.  After watching videos and reading reviews she had hoped the lashes with magnets on each end would be a better fit than the ones with a single magnet in the center.  The problem with these is the lash is straight and gaps at the center, so you find yourself trying to see past the bottom lash that’s in your line of vision.

This product is garbage. I have been ordering from Amazon for years and I had never returned a product until I purchased this one. The lashes literally fell apart as I was trying to apply them. I ordered them because the price was reasonable and immediately regretted not paying more for a better quality product. Way too much! They look so fake. I tried to trim them a little but the magnet fell off. They look hilarious! Don’t waste your money.

I have recently fallen in love with magnetic lashes.  This is the fourth set I have purchased, all different brands.  Putting on magnetic lashes takes some practice.  I have found that attaching the outside magnets first works best.  The trick is to keep the other magnets from connecting before they are in the right place.  This set has a full, one piece lash for the top and three small pieces for the underside.  THIS MAKES IT MUCH EASIER!!!  The lower pieces can be easy to lose if your work are
Really like the small ones for everyday use. The big ones I will try with a full face of make up for special events. They were really easy to put on using the tool that comes with them.

Well, I purchased these same lashes without the dandy little tool.  I had such a bad experience, but I was determined to get those little ****s on my eyes.  Well, the tool was of no help whatsoever.  Those little lash pieces still fell and fluttered around.  I could not even find one piece until I looked in the mirror and found it on my nose.  I even watched YouTube to get tips. Wow, these are fantastic. After trying various other magnetic lashes with poor results i’m ecstatic to find some this good. They were easy to apply, & the plastic tweezers also help. I love that the bottom set are marked with red dots too. Most importantly for me, you couldn’t see the magnets when i applied them. They look seemless & are extremely comfortableto wear. They feel very secure & i will definitely be purchasing these again.

I was not impressed with these lashes at all. They come without any instructions. They are flimsy and poor quality. The applicator they came with was warped and also flimsy-pretty much useless. And because the lashes are flimsy, they are really hard to put on. If you are looking for easy, this brand is not it.

reviews.t: Impossible for me to make work
reviews.x: Have so far spent at least three hours in attempting to get these on my eyelashes. Sometimes with mascara on, sometimes without. Can't for the life of me get them to look natural, or click close to the lash line, or to be even, etc. If you order anyway, best of luck to you!

reviews.t: OVER PRICED JUNK...these do not arch with your lash...
reviews.x: This product is not your typical magnetic eye lash.  These are flat with no curve so they are very hard to put on and when you do get them on they don't arch with your own lash.  Over priced for junk.

reviews.x: These don't contour to the shape of the eye.  They are difficult to line up, and only have magnets on the ends - not the middle to help hold a curve in place.  I find them too difficult to use.

You need to place the TOP eyelashes, the ones that do NOT have a red dot on them, in place on top of your own eyelashes. I had some trouble getting used to putting them on at first, but now I usually get it right on the first try. When I tell my false lash-wearing friends that these are magnetic they are shocked. claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes difficult to apply, often requiring significant practice or trial and error.
Several reviewers report the lashes are straight or flat and do not curve to fit the eye, causing gaps or poor alignment.
Some reviewers describe the lashes as looking fake or unnatural rather than natural.
A number of reviewers complain about poor quality, including flimsy lashes, magnets falling off, and lashes falling apart.
Some reviewers had positive experiences, finding the lashes easy to apply and liking the included tool.
